integrity: Complete reproducible code and two independently replayable constructive decision-tree certificates are supplied. Exact finite upper bounds use exhaustive depth-indexed recursion; separate string-set implementation cross-checks n<=8. No scientific independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact numeric Littlestone classification only for n=1 through 14. An exact recursive characterization works for every finite n, but no larger closed-form numeric theorem is claimed. The VC dimension formula is classical. Historical priority remains uncertain under bounded-run sequence and online segmentation terminology.
title: Finite online-shattering thresholds for unions of two intervals
